description: **Opt-in companions ride the same release tag** — `amore init --with-lucerna` and `amore init --with-speculum` fetch the house steward and session mirror from the matching GitHub Release (sha256-verified, linked beside `amore`); both default off, iris stays default-on with `--no-iris`.

**The system prompt introduces the harness by its right name** — the compiled-in prompt templates lagged their plaintext sources by one commit, leaving a stale product name and docs path in the resident model's system prompt; regenerated, with the regeneration script now shipping in-tree.

**Linux glibc floor lowered to 2.35** — release lanes build on Ubuntu 22.04 runners so binaries run on Ubuntu 22.04+/Debian 12+; the installers now smoke-test the installed binary (must run and print a version) and restore the rollback copy on failure.

**The crowned heart** — the welcome mark is now a gold three-point crown resting on a rose heart, taken from the site's own art and rasterized in braille; both tiers regenerate from `scripts/gen_amore.py`, same shine sweep.

**Iris lands on PATH with the house** — `amore init` links the companion beside the `amore` binary (no manual PATH step), and the planted `AGENTS.md` wires the resident agent to the iris org verbs and `iris regula lint`.

**DeepSeek V4 Flash is the recommended model path** — the wizard's first slot writes `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731` over OpenRouter; GLM-5.2 recipes remain, and the setup docs are model-agnostic (`docs/setup-models.md`).
**Iris installs with the house** — `amore init` downloads the companion by default (`--no-iris` opts out), and the iris daemon now binds loopback only.
**Install one-liners** — installer scripts fetch the newest release asset for your platform, verify its sha256, and keep a rollback of any previous install.
